hover:text-phantom-yellow transition-colors
"><a href="#closing">Closing</a></li></ul></div></aside><!-- MDX Content --><div id="blog-content" class="col-span-1 lg:col-span-9 max-w-none text-white text-pretty"><h2 id="summary">Summary</h2>
<p>Improved core validation performance in Validasi by eliminating hidden O(N²) patterns and reducing unnecessary allocations in hot validation paths.</p>
<h3 id="key-changes">Key changes:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Replaced quadratic uniqueness checks with HashSet-based tracking</li>
<li>Optimized ContainsAll from repeated scans → set membership</li>
<li>Removed unnecessary intermediate allocations in map validation rules</li>
<li>Introduced early-exit logic in high-frequency validation paths</li>
<li>Simplified preprocessing API for safer transformations</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="outcome">Outcome:</h3>
<p>More predictable performance under large datasets and reduced GC pressure in deeply nested validations.</p>
<h2 id="context">Context</h2>
<p>Validasi is a Dart validation library used for structured data validation.</p>
<p>While reviewing the codebase, I noticed several validation rules were doing more work than necessary — especially under large inputs and nested structures.</p>
<p>No redesign. Just removal of inefficiencies in hot paths.</p>
<h1 id="1-hidden-on-in-a-simple-rule">1. Hidden O(N²) in a “Simple” Rule</h1>
<p>One of the core rules, <code>Unique</code>, was implemented using repeated scans:</p>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> seen </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#F97583"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">T</span><span style="color:#F97583">&gt;</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">[];</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">for</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> item </span><span style="color:#F97583">in</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> value) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"> if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (seen.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">any</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">((s) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> s </span><span style="color:#F97583">==</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> item)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> // duplicate</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> seen.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">add</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(item);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<p>At small scale this is fine.</p>
<p>At 10,000 items, it becomes ~50M comparisons.</p>
<p>Nothing in the API suggests this cost.</p>
<h2 id="the-fix">The Fix</h2>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> seen </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#F97583"> &lt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">T</span><span style="color:#F97583">&gt;</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">{};</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">for</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> item </span><span style="color:#F97583">in</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> value) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"> if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">!</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">seen.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">add</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(item)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> // duplicate found</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h3 id="why-this-works">Why this works</h3>
<ul>
<li><code>Set.add()</code> is O(1) average</li>
<li>removes nested scan entirely</li>
<li>same behavior, different complexity profile</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="2-containsall-repeated-scanning-vs-membership">2. ContainsAll: repeated scanning vs membership</h1>
<h2 id="before">Before</h2>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">for</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#F97583"> required</span><span style="color:#F97583"> in</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> elements) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"> if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">!</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">value.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">any</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">((item) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> item </span><span style="color:#F97583">==</span><span style="color:#F97583"> required</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> // fail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 id="after">After</h2>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#F97583"> set</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> value.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">toSet</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">for</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#F97583"> required</span><span style="color:#F97583"> in</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> elements) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"> if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">!set</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">contains</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#F97583">required</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> // fail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h3 id="scan-level-takeaway">Scan-level takeaway</h3>
<ul>
<li>O(N×M) → O(N+M)</li>
<li>avoids repeated full traversal</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="3-allocation-overhead-in-nested-validation">3. Allocation overhead in nested validation</h1>
<h2 id="problem">Problem</h2>
<p>Error propagation was copying paths repeatedly:</p>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">path</span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> [prefix, ...</span><span style="color:#F97583">?</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">path]</span></span></code></pre>
<p>This creates a new list at every nesting level.</p>
<h2 id="fix">Fix</h2>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">void</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> prefix</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">String</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> segment) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> _path </span><span style="color:#F97583">??=</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> [];</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> _path</span><span style="color:#F97583">!</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">insert</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">, segment);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h3 id="tradeoff">Tradeoff</h3>
<ul>
<li>reduces allocations drastically</li>
<li>introduces controlled mutation in error path building</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="4-map-validation-unnecessary-work-elimination">4. Map validation: unnecessary work elimination</h1>
<h2 id="pattern-1-unnecessary-materialization">Pattern 1: unnecessary materialization</h2>
<h3 id="before-1">Before</h3>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> extraKeys </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> value.keys.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">where</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">((k) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#F97583"> !</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">keys.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">contains</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(k)).</span><span style="color:#B392F0">toList</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (extraKeys.isNotEmpty) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> // fail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h3 id="after-1">After</h3>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> extraKeys </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> value.keys.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">where</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">((k) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#F97583"> !</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">keys.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">contains</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(k));</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (extraKeys.isNotEmpty) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D"> // fail</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 id="pattern-2-early-exit-optimization">Pattern 2: early exit optimization</h2>
<h3 id="before-2">Before</h3>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> count </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> fields.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">where</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">((f) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> value.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">containsKey</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(f)).length;</span></span></code></pre>
<h3 id="after-2">After</h3>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#79B8FF">int</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> count </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">for</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">final</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> field </span><span style="color:#F97583">in</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> fields) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"> if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (value.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">containsKey</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(field)) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> count</span><span style="color:#F97583">++</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"> if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (count </span><span style="color:#F97583">&gt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 1</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="color:#F97583">break</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
<h3 id="why-this-matters">Why this matters</h3>
<ul>
<li>avoids full scan when answer is already known</li>
<li>improves worst-case behavior significantly</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="5-preprocessing-api-simplification">5. Preprocessing API simplification</h1>
<h2 id="before-3">Before</h2>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">withPreprocess</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#79B8FF"> ValidasiTransformation</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">String</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">, </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">int</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (value) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> int</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">parse</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(value),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> ),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">);</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 id="after-3">After</h2>
<pre class="astro-code github-dark" style="background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8;overflow-x:auto" tabindex="0" data-language="dart"><code><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">withPreprocess</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">String</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">&gt;(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (value) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> int</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">tryParse</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(value) </span><span style="color:#F97583">??</span><span style="color:#F97583"> -</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">1</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> message</span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> &#39;Failed to parse integer&#39;</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">);</span></span></code></pre>
<h2 id="what-changed">What changed</h2>
<ul>
<li>removed wrapper abstraction</li>
<li>made transformation explicit and direct</li>
<li>added failure messaging at API level</li>
</ul>
<p>This reduces:</p>
<ul>
<li>boilerplate per schema</li>
<li>cognitive overhead per transformation</li>
<li>risk of unsafe parsing (<code>parse</code> → <code>tryParse</code>)</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="6-tradeoffs">6. Tradeoffs</h1>
<p>This is intentionally pragmatic engineering:</p>
<ul>
<li>Sets introduce small allocation overhead</li>
<li>Mutating error paths reduces immutability purity</li>
<li>Early-exit logic increases control flow complexity</li>
</ul>
<p>But:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>The system is used on every validation path. That makes CPU efficiency matters more than theoretical purity.</p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="7-result-summary">7. Result Summary</h1>
<h2 id="complexity-improvements">Complexity improvements</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unique: O(N²) → O(N)</li>
<li>ContainsAll: O(N×M) → O(N+M)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="runtime-improvements">Runtime improvements</h2>
<ul>
<li>fewer allocations in nested validation</li>
<li>reduced GC pressure in error-heavy workloads</li>
<li>improved early-exit behavior in hot paths</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="api-improvements">API improvements</h2>
<ul>
<li>simpler preprocessing model</li>
<li>clearer transformation intent</li>
<li>more consistent rule behavior via <code>keySelector</code></li>
</ul>
<h1 id="closing">Closing</h1>
<p>This wasn’t a planned optimization effort.</p>
<p>It came from reviewing the code and removing unnecessary work in hot paths.</p>
<p>The end result is a validation library that behaves more predictably under scale — both in algorithmic complexity and memory behavior.</p></div></div></article></main><div class="fixed top-0 left-0
